name: Victoria Golf Resort & Spa
insider_take: This championship golf resort sits on Portugal's stunning Golden Coast, where dramatic clifftops meet pristine beaches and world-class fairways.
whats_special: The resort features two championship golf courses designed by Arnold Palmer and Christy O'Connor Jr., plus direct access to Praia da Falésia - one of Europe's most beautiful beaches with its iconic red limestone cliffs. The spa incorporates traditional Portuguese therapies using local sea salt and algae.
pro_tip: Book tee times for early morning to avoid crowds and enjoy cooler temperatures, then spend your afternoon exploring the dramatic sea caves at nearby Benagil - accessible by kayak or boat tour.
dont_miss: The sunset views from Hole 16 overlooking the Atlantic, and a day trip to charming Tavira with its Roman bridge and traditional salt pans where flamingos gather seasonally.
pros: Championship golf course on-site with stunning fairway views
Full-service spa offering rejuvenating treatments and wellness facilities
Prime Algarve location with easy access to beaches and attractions
Luxury accommodations with modern amenities and elegant design
cons: Golf-focused resort may not appeal to non-golfers
